details:
I suggest adding individual visibility toggles for nameplate icons, allowing users to choose which icons they want to see.

Different situations require different information. For example:

- PC-only worlds: Platform icons are unnecessary.

- Friends/private instances: Trust Rank may be irrelevant.

- Events with avatar performance restrictions: Performance Rank may not be needed.

- 18+ verified worlds: Age Verification icons may provide redundant information.

- Avatar interaction-focused activities: Interaction icons can be very useful.

Instead of deciding that certain icons should always be shown or removed, let users customize them according to their needs.

Each icon should have its own independent toggle. Categories can be used to organize the settings menu, but icons within the same category should not be linked together.

This would allow users to reduce unnecessary visual clutter while still keeping the icons that are useful to them. It would also provide a flexible system for any new nameplate icons added in the future.
title: Allow users to individually toggle nameplate icons
